about: The two SJC Strix Halo pods as the existing helpers saw them on 2026-10-10, for python -m lab placement and its tests. status.json is the answer of python -m lab.controller status --probe-port 8000 for accounts C and D (made by make_status.py from the recorded hub state); <node>.facts.txt is the output of bash lab/pod_a_teacher.sh facts as the R29 and R30 task pages recorded it; power is the telemetry.gpu.power sample file lab/pod_power.py wrote on pod C during the T6 run (gpu-a). A live snapshot is the same files written today under <state dir>/placement.
